integrity.claim_consistency: The threshold, maximizing ratio and spectral/operator separation are identical across the documents.
integrity.proven_scope: Necessary-and-sufficient all-vector one-step norm threshold and unique parameterwise maximum, by explicit algebra.
integrity.reproducibility: Includes a standalone SymPy/NumPy checker and a dependency list; executable checks are supplemental to the proof.

scientific_limitations: Sharp only for constant-coefficient planar damped oscillators with both damping and coupling strictly positive.
Concerns one-step Euclidean energy nonexpansion of the two-stage second-order explicit RK stability polynomial, not arbitrary matrices, other norms, or nonlinear problems.
At the boundary the inequality is non-strict; the general mathematical priority of the special-case formula has not been independently checked.
title: A sharp energy-contraction frontier for explicit RK2 on damped oscillators
